analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is an integer-overflow/underflow in bounds computation for .debug_str_offsets indexing. In _dwarf_extract_string_offset_via_str_offsets(), attacker-controlled index_to_offset_entry is multiplied and added into offsetintable/end_offsetintable using unsigned arithmetic (indexoffset = index*length_size; offsetintable = indexoffset + baseoffset + table_offset_to_array; end_offsetintable = offsetintable + length_size). The code only checks end_offsetintable > sectionlen, but does not detect wraparound of offsetintable/end_offsetintable. When overflow occurs, end_offsetintable can appear in-range while offsetintable points before/invalid relative to section start, leading READ_UNALIGNED_CK/_dwarf_memcpy_noswap_bytes to read out of bounds (ASan shows 4-byte read 4 bytes before allocated section buffer).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via fuzz_die_cu_print when parsing a CU DIE that reaches dwarf_formstring() on a strx/str_index form, causing _dwarf_extract_string_offset_via_str_offsets() to consume attacker-controlled .debug_str_offsets index/base metadata from malformed DWARF. Required condition is crafted values such that unsigned arithmetic in offset table address calculation wraps (or otherwise produces inconsistent start/end), bypassing the single end>sectionlen check and causing an OOB read from de_debug_str_offsets section data loaded by _dwarf_load_section().
